messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: cross-region routing queue surge detected. scope=eu-west -> us-east, metric=inflight_queue_len, spike_start=1799998820, current_spike=18x baseline, symptom=5xx spikes and tail latency increase. paging on-call. :rotating_light:
sara_ops: ack. paging @micah_oncall, @ivan_net. seeing early CS reports of timeouts from EU customers.
micah_oncall: oncall here, joining. quick question: any recent steering policy changes in the last 30m?
ivan_net: yes — last change was a weighting tweak (policy-id: steer-2026-03-17-09) ~22m ago. I'm seeing continuous increase in proxy inflight queues on eu-west2 egress to us-east, backlog especially on connection pools.
micah_oncall: good context. running quick probe to list per-route inflight: 
```
# probe: aggregate inflight per destination
routemgr probe inflight --since 5m --region eu-west --group-by dest
```
micah_oncall: probe shows several destinations to us-east with inflight=400-900 (norm ~20-50).
alex_sre: suggestion: target a temporary pin override for affected prefixes so EU traffic stays local while we mitigate egress surge. this avoids broad policy rollback. need sign-off.
jordan_eng: caution — pin override will change affinity and may bypass some canary rules. if we do it, should scope to the specific ASNs/prefixes seen in the probe. I can craft the exact command if we decide.
sara_ops: @micah_oncall do we have customer impact numbers? lia_support reported a small cohort of paying customers hitting 5xx.
micah_oncall: impact: ~2.3% of total requests in eu-west are 5xx over the last 10m, median p95 latency up from 120ms -> 1.6s. customer-reported pages: 4 distinct customers with elevated errors. marking as potential P0 until we stabilize.
lia_support: prepping customer-facing blurb (short): "Experiencing higher latency and intermittent errors for EU-based requests. Engineers are investigating; mitigations being applied now. We'll update in 15 minutes."
ivan_net: alternative: revert the policy change (steer-2026-03-17-09) — that's faster and less invasive than pin override. rollback would reestablish prior weights. downside: rollback is broader.
alex_sre: agree rollback simpler. any compatibility issues for long-running sessions? should be fine.
jordan_eng: prepared rollback command: 
```
routemgr policy rollback --id steer-2026-03-17-09 --target previous
```
micah_oncall: executing rollback now. posting output.
micah_oncall: ```
$ routemgr policy rollback --id steer-2026-03-17-09 --target previous
rolling back policy steer-2026-03-17-09...
apply: success on control-plane nodes (3/3). propagation started to edge.
expected convergence window: ~45s-2m
```
incident-bot: POLICY_ROLLBACK: steer-2026-03-17-09 marked rolled_back by micah_oncall at 1799998905. propagation metric shows start.
ivan_net: seeing inflight queues drop in eu-west2 now, numbers moving toward baseline. egress to us-east queue length halved within 40s.
maya_prod: monitoring dashboards show 5xx rate dropping, p95 latency trending down. great. recommend observe for 15m before closing.
sara_ops: assigning follow-up RCA ticket: RNW-INC-2026-0891 (P1) — include timeline, policy diff, and suggested guardrails to prevent future weight overshoots.
micah_oncall: PR created for temporary blameless postmortem notes. plan: collect telemetry, correlate requests per-customer, and check connection pool configs.
lia_support: customer blurb sent to impacted accounts. will update channel with any replies.
alex_sre: note: consider adding a safety bump cap on weight deltas in steering operator to prevent >3x increases in a single change. adding to RNW-ENG-2026 backlog.
jordan_eng: logging a config rollback event and pinning the policy change for later staged rollout with canary flags.
sara_ops: final check: anyone see residual errors or oddness?
ivan_net: nothing abnormal now.
maya_prod: metrics stable for last 90s.
micah_oncall: closing handoff to postmortem process. will keep channel open for 30m for monitoring. thanks all. :thumbsup:
